parts.gloss: he who does not (negative pronominal suffix)

words.gloss: he who does not rid himself of

literal: He who does not rid himself of anger, who has no self-control, at all times, in all places, to anyone, is easy.
translation: One who does not rid himself of anger and lacks self-control is easy for anyone to defeat, at any time and in any place.
modern: கோபத்தை விடாதவனும், மன அடக்கம் இல்லாதவனுமாகிய ஒருவன், எக்காலத்திலும், எவ்விடத்திலும், யாருக்கும் எளிதில் வெல்லக்கூடியவன் ஆவான்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the fatal vulnerabilities of an undisciplined adversary. A person who cannot free themselves from anger (வெகுளி) and lacks the strength of self-control (நிறை) becomes entirely predictable and weak. Because of these internal flaws, they can be easily conquered by any opponent (யார்க்கும்), at any given time (எஞ்ஞான்றும்), and in any location (யாங்கணும்). Their emotional instability deprives them of strategic defense, making them an easy target.
